Confirmed registrations.reconfirmed_at (schema.ts line 261) is REQ-011's original, previously-unused column, not new. Read apps/bot/src/domain/notification.ts in full: ComposedMessage's new discriminated union (text/photo/skip), NotificationSender's new sendPhoto(), and confirmed step 4 (ledger INSERT) still unconditionally precedes step 5 (send attempt) -- REQ-025's ordering is unchanged -- with the new 'skip' -> skipped-stale outcome added as an at-send-time admission recheck that consumes the ledger row without sending. Read apps/bot/src/index.ts and confirmed the real sequencing fix: `await bot.init()` now runs before startScheduledJobs() and bot.start(), fixing a genuine pre-existing gap where the T-3h job's immediate-on-startup tick (REQ-025's restart-catch-up rule) could fire before bot.botInfo.username was populated.
